caveat: Separately scheduled measured medians, not paired causal trials or significance bounds. Break-even estimates compare cold+(N-1)*warm CPU/native or elapsed/Wasm on repeated same-size inputs in an otherwise fresh process. Other histories can reuse larger tables. Tiny cold clocks are not used. The feature comparison includes route/leaf changes. Only the equal-leaf controls isolate twiddle policy; even their owned-twiddle mode can retain matrix tables when cache is enabled.
